verdict.rationale: Automatic PR review is a fair question for an AI coding tool, so the axis applies. The evidence pack documents no PR-triggered review feature. The `--message` scripting mode, `/ask`, and lint/test hooks are building blocks or adjacent features. The community comment about adding a review step after each PR describes a hypothetical user-built workflow, not a product capability.

support.subject: As a developer, I can get automatic code review with contextual feedback on every pull request
